name: Hats Off (VST3)
description: A hi-hat and cymbal synthesiser: no samples, every hit synthesised. Studio hats, rides, crashes and a china, the drum machines' circuit cymbals, and hats for techno, dub and dubstep, from a ringing plate of bronze and the square waves that imitated it. The plate rings its low modes one by one, where a cymbal's pitch lives, and lays a wash over the top the way a real one does. Closed, pedal and open on the GM notes with a choke, bell to edge, bloom, sizzle, a tempo-synced dub echo, four drives from Battlestar Overdrive and forty-four presets in six banks. The third of the trilogy, after Kickstart and Snare Tactics.
note: Windows VST3 + standalone · build 260926.1 · free download · 31 controls · closed, pedal, open, bell, edge · choke · wide stereo + dub echo · 4 Battlestar drives · 44 presets · manual included.
